content.text:
I added a `support` role to `src/permissions.js` that can view invoices but not edit them, set up the same way as `viewer`. All five tests pass.

Every invoice operation in `src/invoices.js` already checks permissions through `canView` or `canEdit`, so I didn't need to change that file. Support staff can list and open invoices. Trying to update or delete one fails with `forbidden`.

I added two tests in `test/permissions.test.js`:
- One checks the role's view and edit permissions directly.
- One runs through the actual invoice functions as a support user. Listing and reading work, update and delete are rejected, and the invoice amount stays the same afterward.

I haven't committed anything.
